oracle.method: declared linear response and affine utilities
oracle.independence_basis: Exact rational evaluation of the data-generating equation Y=1+2A+0.2X on the 80-point symmetric X grid (E[X]=0 verified, not assumed), giving intervention means 3 and 5 and the caller-declared affine utilities 2*m1-1=5 and 0.5*m2=2.5. The generator evaluates the structural mean by exact arithmetic over the declared grid and applies the declared affine maps; no regression is fitted and no Antecedent code is imported. The utility rules are caller declarations repeated in the fixture, so the check is of the arithmetic, not of the declared utilities' merit.
asserted_outputs: affine utilities of actions A and B
context_only_outputs: native_means and external_means (not read by an executing assertion)
oracle.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README and the executing assertion's data construction; no product implementation source was consulted. Authorship of the original arithmetic is unrecorded.
